english.title: Talkin' bout Toxins, Mon
english.detail:
Something funny be happenin' over there at Gloomrise. Ol' Mazu'kon be hearin all about these nasty new beasties skitterin' all around there.

Some say those creepy crawlies got a venom that have some unique properties and this be gettin' me curious. Take my extractor. Use it on the dead bodies layin' around that place to harvest the venom. Do this and I be in ya debt, mon.
english.objective: Use the Toxin Extractor to gather 5 Gloomrise Toxin Samples from the Gnawed Corpses at Gloomrise.
english.progress: Did ya get what I need?
english.complete:
Heh... when I said unique properties, I wasn't kiddin' mon! You seem no worse for wear, so it be all good.

Thank you for your aid, <class>. It be much appreciated.

english.title: Defending the Dead
english.detail:
There is an ancient tauren burial ground at the place called Gloomrise, just northwest of this camp. Of late it has been infested with a particularly vicious brood of spiders. These spiders not only pose a threat to the people of Mulgore, they are also damaging a site that most tauren consider to be sacred.

It would be of great service if you could travel to Gloomrise and put an end to this infestation. The ancestors will surely smile upon you if you see this done.
english.objective: Kill 10 Gloomrise Hatchlings and 5 Gloomrise Soldiers.
english.progress: The spirits of our ancestors need to rest easy, once again.
english.complete: Thank you for your service to the people of this land. It may take time for us to completely clear out the infestation, but your efforts have created a stable foothold for us to leverage against these vile creatures.

english.title: Stronger than Steel
english.detail:
Have you heard what befell the burial ground at Gloomrise? Giant spiders--rumored to have a venom so strong that it can wake the dead--have spread like wildfire. Nasty business, if you ask me.

One of the scouts dispatched to investigate returned half dead and covered in an incredibly resilient, crystalline spider silk. I harvested what I could, but I would highly value more samples of this silk for additional study.

Bring me more of this crystalline silk and I will reward you.
english.objective: Gather 3 strands of Crystalline Silk from Gloomrise Spinners.
english.progress: This silk's remarkable properties could be used to make lightweight, durable cloth with remarkable defensive properties. I am eager to experiment with more of it.
english.complete:
These are excellent samples, and more than sufficient for my needs.

Here, take this. I was able to craft a rather unique cloak with a weave I spun from the small sample of silk already in my possession. I am hopeful that you will find it useful in your travels.

Earthmother watch over you, <class>.

english.title: The Broodmother
english.detail:
As is often the case with infestations such as the one we are facing at Gloomrise, a single powerful matriarch often leads to the rapid spread of a hostile spider population.

If we wish to drive these beasts off for good, we'll need to seek out the progenitor and end her. When you go to Gloomrise, seek out the broodmother there and destroy her. I'd advise you to bring allies, and be ready for anything. These seem to be no ordinary spiders.
english.objective: Kill Broodmother Valraxx at Gloomrise.
english.progress: Have you destroyed the broodmother, <class>?
english.complete:
Reanimated dead? The broodmother possessing a night elven form? These are troubling revelations. One has to wonder what it all means... I fear that must be a concern for a later time.

Thank you, <name>. You've done the Earthen Ring and the people of Mulgore a great service.

english.title: A Darker Truth
english.detail:
<The Broodmother you just killed is no spider at all, but rather a night elf druid who assumed a twisted animal form. A variety of questions flood your mind about the nature--and purpose--of the spiders at Gloomrise.

You notice a note peeking out of the folds of the dead elf's robe. Perhaps this document may answer some of the questions filling your head.>
english.objective: Bring the letter you recovered from Broodmother Valraxx to Muln Earthfury at Skywatcher Plateau.
english.progress: What is this?
english.complete:
This is... most disturbing. Why would a druid be behind a brood of dangerous spiders? Who or what is this "Wild King" and "Pact" that is referenced in this letter?

I will confer with the druids of the Cenarion Circle on this. Perhaps they will know more.

Thank you again for your aid. As disturbing as this information is, we will rest easier knowing that the person controlling these vile creatures has been destroyed.

english.title: Homeward Bound
english.detail:
Please help me, <class>! I've been hiding here in Highperch for some time now and it's been days since I've seen a friendly face. I came here to study the wyvern and I think I got a little too close. After being chased away from one of the nests I got lost.

I need to get back to Whitereach Post! Motega does not know that I am missing and will be furious to know that I ventured into Highperch by myself.

Whitereach Post is just east of here... please take me there!
english.objective: Escort Pao'ka Swiftmountain from Highperch, and then talk to Motega Firemane in Whitereach Post.
english.complete:
What!? If I knew that Pao'ka Swiftmountain was going to snoop around Highperch, I would have chained him to a totem! His father was reluctant allowing him to come with me to Thousand Needles. We came here to study the different creatures that inhabit these beautiful lands.

I appreciate the help you have shown Pao'ka. I hope this covers any misfortunes this deed has cost you.

english.title: Assassination Plot
english.detail: The Tauren, Kanati Greycloud is bold to set up a hunting camp in Thousand Needles. We must kill him to rid this hunting camp and all who may follow him. We will converge at the small post Southwest of the Great Lift.
english.objective: Warn Kanati Greycloud at Whitereach Post of the plot to kill him.
english.complete: They come to kill me?  I will show them how a Tauren fights!

english.title: Free at Last
english.detail:
Arnak thinks we're going to be married... but after I declined his offer he came back that night and kidnapped me. My brother tried to stop him, but Arnak was too strong. He... he slew my brother and then brought me here.  My poor brother...

<name>, could you escort me out of the Darkcloud Pinnacle?  Please... I need to get back to Thalia! She must be worried sick about me.
english.objective: Escort Lakota Windsong from the Darkcloud Pinnacle, and then talk to Thalia Amberhide at Freewind Post.
english.complete: Thank you, <name>. Deep in my bones I knew that she would find her way back to me. She told me of your bravery and how you helped her escape. These items belonged to her brother. I know she would want you to have them.

english.title: WANTED: Arnak Grimtotem
english.detail:
Wanted: Arnak Grimtotem

Arnak the outcast is wanted for the heinous crimes of murder and kidnapping. Handsome rewards will be given to those brave enough to bring this criminal to justice.

Arnak was last seen on the cliffs near the Darkcloud Pinnacle. Show the proof of your deed to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post in order to claim the reward.
english.objective: Slay Arnak Grimtotem and bring proof of your deed to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post.
english.progress: Have you any news of that murderous Arnak Grimtotem?
english.complete:
Hah! Well, this is excellent news! I was starting to think that he would never be brought to justice!

Here you are, <name>... and thanks. News of Arnak's foul deeds boiled my blood!

english.title: Hypercapacitor Gizmo
english.detail:
I am the only survivor from our caravan attack by the centaur! A rare yet mighty panther is guarding my best gizmo, which is around his neck. Hah! Even the centaur tremble in the presence of this ferocious beast!

Here is the key to the cage. They took everything there, but left him alone. Slay this beast and bring back my hypercapacitor, and I shall reward you.

The wrecked caravan is just north of here.
english.objective: Slay the beast and bring back the Hypercapacitor Gizmo and Panther Cage Key to Wizlo Bearingshiner.
english.progress: Do you have my hypercapacitor?
english.complete: My hypercapacitor! This will keep me busy for a while until I can figure out what it does...

english.title: Pristine Pesterhide Pelts
english.detail:
The Pesterhide hyenas of Thousand Needles have the most gorgeous coats. I haven't seen such a brilliant hue of fur like that in all of my travels!

I would like to send back some pelts to my sisters back in Stormwind, as I know they could make something incredible out of them.

I don't have any fighting experience, so I would be very grateful if you could gather some of the Pesterhide pelts in my stead.
english.objective: Bring 5 Pristine Pesterhide Pelts to Kristy Grant.
english.progress: Were you able to collect the pelts? Rendow has promised to help me clean and tan them to send back home! I know my sisters will be very excited.
english.complete: Thank you, <name>! These hides are in perfect condition. I can't imagine it was easy to get so many, but I am very grateful to you for your work.

english.title: Packaged Pristine Pelts
english.detail:
<name>, you have been so helpful to me I hate to ask for yet another favor. It will be some time until I am able to return home to Stormwind. I was wondering if you would mind delivering these pelts to my sisters in my stead?

I am sure you are more likely to return there before I am able to. Please deliver these pelts to my sisters Kelly and Kimberly in Stormwind. They can usually be found in the Park.
english.objective: Bring the Package of Pristine Pelts to Kimberly Grant.
english.complete:
This is from our sister? We hadn't heard from her in some time. I hope she is doing well.

My, these pelts have such a beautiful color of fur! Kelly and I will make sure we put these to good use.

Thank you for making the long journey. It is good to know Kristy is still doing well and is thinking of us.

english.title: Dangerous!
english.detail:
Dangerous!

The following humans of Hillsbrad have been deemed dangerous and are marked for bounty by High Executor Darthalia:

Clerk Horrace Whitesteed.  Wanted for the murder of Deathguard Toma.

Citizen Wilkes.  Wanted for the murder of Apothecary Eli.

Miner Hackett.  Wanted for the murder of Deathstalker Fry.

Farmer Kalaba.  Wanted for the ambush of supplies from the Undercity.

All of these enemies are hiding and will be hard to find.  A reward will be granted upon notice of their death.
english.objective: High Executor Darthalia of Tarren Mill is offering a bounty on Clerk Horrace Whitesteed, Citizen Wilkes, Miner Hackett and Farmer Kalaba.
english.progress: Yes?
english.complete: You are quite the bounty hunter, <class>.  Well done.

english.title: Hillsbrad's Hoard
english.detail:
Hillsbrad's council hasn't answered our new magistrate's letters. The last word I pried out of a passing merchant from the town did little to justify their silence.

We're only asking for a small platoon--yet I'm told multiple siege ballista rest in pristine condition within a walled-off compound.

Walk into their town hall like a citizen returning a census request, and place this neatly upon the bookkeeping table.

Return to me when the deed is done.
english.objective: Place the Sealed Company Request you were given on the bookkeeping table within Hillsbrad's town hall.
english.complete:
Good work, soldier. I know you're not stationed with us, but we never turn away capable hands.

If they don't respond to THIS letter, we'll have to be more crude in our messaging.

We'll keep you on reserve for civilian interactions should the need arise again.

english.title: Brewer's Trade
english.detail:
Worked a bit o' a trade with the Dun Garok brew-kin. We're not the only ones missin' the vineyards of the Fallrook family, it seems! Most o' the best bottled years are long since drank, but we do have cases of the wine still in the cellars. 

Bring this case of Fallrook Varietal to Dun Garok in the southeast and leave it with 'em by their gatherin' fireplace at the bottom of their fort.

In return, carry a sack o' the Homebrew Hops back with ye.

That keep is the closest thing to home around here!
english.objective: Deliver the bottles of Fallrook Varietal to Dun Garok in southeast Hillsbrad Foothills, and bring back a sack of their Homebrew Hops.
english.progress: Lookin' ta try a new ale?
english.complete:
That's the hops smell I missed! Ye done me a great favor, <name>, takes me days to leave every time I make the trip to Dun Garok myself. Hard to pull me self outta the halls o' that fortress once I get comfortable.

Happy to keep some old tastes on the shelf for fellow dwarves.

Have a little somethin' for helpin out.

english.title: The Lost Pages
english.detail:
I just picked up this shredder from Ratchet and I was on my way back to the Warsong Lumber Camp, where I am supposed to be on duty. I was given a manual on how to operate the shredder, but on the trip back, a huge gust of wind blew it from my hands. The pages went everywhere, and all I was left with was the cover.

The pages could be just about anywhere by now, I suppose... but I don't know how to use the shredder without them! Will you find them for me?
english.objective: Find the 12 missing pages of the Shredder Operating Manual, and put them together to form Chapters 1, 2, and 3. Return the pages to Gurda Ragescar near Splintertree Post.
english.progress: I hope you find the pages soon, <name>! I really need to get back to work!
english.complete: Reading isn't my strong point... but now I'll be able to get back to work! Thanks, <name>!

english.title: Amongst the Ruins
english.detail:
The Twilight's Hammer has moved into the Moonshrine Ruins of Blackfathom Deeps.  Their presence can only serve to coerce the elements into working against us.  If left unchecked, this region will be theirs for good.

<name>, go into Blackfathom and find the ruin's fathom stone; it should be somewhere close in the water.  In it is a fathom core - a device that when properly read it will relate a history of all elemental activity.  If I have it, I and the Earthen Ring can maybe do something to stop them!
english.objective: Bring the Fathom Core to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.
english.progress: Have you been successful in locating the fathom core?  Without it we'll have no idea what the Twilight's Hammer is exactly up to down there.
english.complete:
This is exactly what I need!  A fathom core is an incredible well of information that we will be able to draw much good from.  Whatever the Twilight's Hammer is up to in there - and believe me when I say it is no good - my comrades and I will now uncover.

You've done well here today; the Earthen Ring looks upon you warmly for assisting us.  You've also helped the Horde as a whole, and for that you should be proud.

english.title: Baron Aquanis
english.detail:
The defeated water elemental has left behind a strange water globe.  You surmise that the object somehow fed the beast energy.  Inside the globe, a putrid-looking form of water sloshes about.  The globe itself seems impervious to any sort of physical force.

If anyone can make any sense of this item, it would be Je'neu Sancrea of the Earthen Ring.  He is located at the Horde's Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale.
english.objective: Bring the Strange Water Globe to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.
english.progress: Ah, hello again <name>.  I was just reading the waves the sea, much like I always do.  What brings you to the outpost?
english.complete:
This... this is quite the find, <name>.

You acquired this from Baron Aquanis in Blackfathom, you say?  Baron Aquanis has long been thought of as a corrupted elemental power; this globe will prove what exactly had corrupted him.  While it would be no surprise if it turned out to be the Twilight's Hammer, our studies will also show how they did it as well.

You did well in bringing this to me.  Please - take this, along with the Earthen Ring's warmest regards.

english.title: A New Ore Sample
english.detail:
<class>, you have done well in helping me in the past. The warchief is pleased thus far with what I've accomplished, and asks me to continue with renewed determination. My honor dictates that I give you proper recognition to the warchief for all you have done, but first I would ask you for your help again.

Travelers recently came from the south from a place called Thousand Needles. There they killed a kobold who had an unusual ore sample, but they would not sell it. I want a sample of that ore to examine.
english.objective: Find an Unrefined Ore Sample on a Gravelsnout Digger or Surveyor and bring it to Tatternack Steelforge at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
english.progress:
I saw the travelers again--the ones that would not sell me a sample of the ore. I spit at them for not helping the warchief.

May they die in battle like cowards and not like warriors as should be the right of all people who ally themselves with the Horde.
english.complete:
A good sample, <name>. A good sample indeed.

Those travelers can no longer lord over me the ore they found, now that you have been successful.

I shall get to work on it immediately. If it proves strong enough, I will send a weapon crafted from the material back to the warchief to show him our success.

I shall not forget your help, <class>.
